{{Quote|You were close to one of them?''"<br />"''Tutso Mara. We trained together. He taught me how to hold my lightsaber correctly.|Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />}}
'''Tutso Mara''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who, at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], worked in service to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During his [[Jedi training/Legends|studies]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Mara became friends with fellow student [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], whom he aided in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] training. In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]], after being [[Jedi Trials/Legends|elevated]] to Jedi Knighthood, Mara [[Death/Legends|perished]] with other Jedi and Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], which Offee engineered in protest of the Jedi Order's increasingly militant role in leading the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] into warfare. Mara and the five other Jedi victims were memorialized in a [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|ceremony]] at the Temple, which [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] oversaw, and their bodies were then laid to rest.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Live for the living Jedi, we must. Live through us, forever they will.|Yoda, eulogizing Mara and the other bombing victims|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />}}
Tutso Mara lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the course of his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Mara befriended another trainee, [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. He helped her in learning [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], specifically with the correct [[Limb/Legends|hand]] grip for her [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> and further assisted her in honing her combat techniques as [[Time/Legends|time]] went on.<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]], with the Jedi Order becoming the leaders of the newly created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], as part of the Republic's pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Mara eventually [[Jedi Trials/Legends|attained]] the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-episode-guide|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Sabotage Date" /> His friend Offee similarly approached a promotion to Knighthood around the same time.<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref><ref name="FF-2014 61: Offee">{{FactFile2014|61|OFF 1-6|Barriss Offee}}</ref>

[[File:TempleBombingFuneral.png|thumb|left|250px|Tutso Mara is laid to rest with the other Jedi victims of the bombing.]]
In 19.1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the final [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of that year,<ref name="Sabotage Date" /> Mara was at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> He and five other Jedi Knights<ref name="Episode Guide" /> were in the Temple [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] when it was targeted for a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|terrorist bombing]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> The engineer of the plot was Offee, who had grown disgusted with the way the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had led the Order into heightened militancy.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> A series of volatile [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]] executed the bombing,<ref name="Sabotage" /> [[Death/Legends|claiming the lives]] of Mara, his Jedi colleagues, and a number of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were present in the hangar,<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> and sowing further injuries to many [[Temple employee|civilian workers]].<ref name="Sabotage" />

While the Jedi Order and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] launched investigations into the attack, the Order held a [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|memorial service]] for Mara and the other Jedi who had lost their lives in the blast. Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] eulogized Mara and his fallen comrades before the mourners who had gathered at the Temple, including Offee and other Jedi as well as prominent Republic [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] and [[Republic officer/Legends|military officers]]. Mara's body and those of the other victims were then laid to rest in the Temple.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> Although Offee tried to frame fellow Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] for the bombing of the Temple Hangar, Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] exposed Offee's exploits, and she was [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|arrested]] and taken into Republic custody.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:BarrissVsAnakin-TWJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Mara's friend Barriss Offee orchestrated the bombing that claimed his life.]]
Tutso Mara was close with Barriss Offee, their friendship stemming from their mutual time in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> Mara took the effort to further help Offee sharpen her combat skills,<ref name="TCWEG" /> of which she remained appreciative even after she became a Jedi Knight. Despite Offee's role in the bombing that took his life, Mara's death greatly distressed her.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

==Powers and abilities==
Being sensitive to the Force, Mara trained as a Jedi. His proficiency was such that he was elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight.<ref name="Episode Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For those keeping track, the Jedi that Barriss Offee references at the memorial service is Tutso Mara, with whom she studied lightsaber techniques. Mara was one of six Jedi killed in the blast.|The Trivia Gallery for "The Jedi Who Knew Too Much"|<ref name="Episode Guide" />}}
Tutso Mara was first mentioned&mdash;as one of the unnamed Jedi Knights killed in the bombing of the Jedi Temple&mdash;in the preview version of [[StarWars.com]]'s online guide for "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]," an episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. The episode, which aired on [[February 16]], [[2013]],<ref name="Episode Guide" /> identified Mara's character by name and also depicted his draped body in the memorial service at the Jedi Temple.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> The character has since been referenced in author [[Jason Fry]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' ([[June]] 2013).<ref name="TCWEG" />
